title: Receptive-field-constrained stimulus optimization for human early and intermediate visual cortex
abstract: arXiv:2609.36391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An ongoing challenge in sensory neuroscience is to characterize the feature dimensions encoded by cortical populations. Recent approaches probe feature selectivity in a data-driven way, by synthesizing a most-exciting-input (MEI) for a target neural population. While this approach has been successfully applied to human higher visual cortex using fMRI data, generating MEIs for early- and mid-level retinotopic visual areas requires additional modeling constraints due to small receptive field sizes. To address this challenge, we introduce two novel MEI generation frameworks, Receptive Field Diffusion for Visual Exploration (RF-DiVE) and Receptive Field Gradient Optimization (RF-GO). Both methods use a population receptive field (pRF)-constrained voxelwise encoding model; RF-DiVE combines this with a pretrained latent diffusion model, while RF-GO uses regularized gradient ascent. translated_title: 面向人类早期和中期视觉皮层的感受野约束刺激优化
translated_abstract: 感觉神经科学中一个持续的挑战是表征皮层神经元群所编码的特征维度。最近的方法以数据驱动的方式探测特征选择性，即通过为目标神经元群合成最兴奋输入。虽然这种方法已借助fMRI数据成功应用于人类高级视觉皮层，但由于感受野尺寸较小，为早期和中期视网膜拓扑视觉区域生成MEI需要额外的建模约束。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了两种新颖的MEI生成框架：视觉探索感受野扩散模型和感受野梯度优化。两种方法均使用群体感受野约束的体素级编码模型；RF-DiVE将其与预训练的潜在扩散模型相结合，而RF-GO则采用正则化梯度上升方法。当应用于视网膜拓扑定义区域中的单体素时……
tldr: 本文提出了RF-DiVE和RF-GO两种新颖的最兴奋输入生成框架，通过群体感受野约束的编码模型分别结合潜在扩散模型和正则化梯度上升，成功解决了为人类早期和中期视觉皮层小感受野区域进行刺激优化的难题。
